notes: Recombinant WT cargo-free shell. 7KQ5 is the high-resolution flavin-bound WT shell. 9Y8P is a later WT shell reconstruction and does not represent a distinct geometry, so both PDBs are grouped in this assembly. Nakamura et al. 2026 further showed that recombinant TmEnc can undergo acid-induced disassembly followed by reassembly upon return to neutral pH, supporting the reversible assembly behavior of the T=1 scaffold; this study used a C-terminally His-tagged construct rather than the exact WT constructs represented by 7KQ5/9Y8P.
shell_sequence_change: No engineered alteration of the WT shell protein is recorded for this assembly.
